x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: sidub-config: select, snapshot and check a Sidub application's configuration environments.

options.name: --app
options.description: The application's appsettings.json, or its folder (default: the current folder).

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Write the environment's store to this machine's snapshot.

options.name: --no-secrets
options.description: Keep Key Vault references as stored (a host refuses them until a later source replaces them). [default: False]

options.name: --secrets
options.description: Resolve Key Vault references (the default except for production, where it is refused). [default: False]

arguments.name: ENV
arguments.description: The environment, as Sidub:Configuration:Environments names it.

commands.name: use
commands.description: Select the environment and source the application's hosts read on this machine.

options.name: --live
options.description: Read the environment's store at start (the default). [default: False]

options.name: --snapshot
options.description: Read this machine's snapshot of the environment. [default: False]

arguments.name: ENV
arguments.description: The environment, as Sidub:Configuration:Environments names it.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Probe the environment's store and vault, and name each role this identity lacks.

arguments.name: ENV
arguments.description: The environment, as Sidub:Configuration:Environments names it.
